Centrality ruling, definitive: no ESCALATE. Sentence 1 states the article's central event and its title in the same polarity as the source, 大規模な不正の証拠は発見できていない, so the summary's message is neither reversed nor invented. The fabricated sentence is explicitly hedged as 選挙結果を左右しない規模, so it neither inverts nor displaces the central finding; it is an invented sub-claim standing beside an intact central event. Under the rubric boundary that a reversed or invented minor sub-claim stays inside soft scoring, and under the GROUNDED_PERIPHERAL_DEFECT counter-example, this is a heavy faithfulness penalty, not FACTUAL_REVERSAL and not FABRICATED_CONTENT.
